title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 16: the Day of Atonement: Aaron in the Most Holy Place, the two goats and the yearly statute.

questions.text: After whose death did Yahweh give Moses these instructions?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Yahweh and died.

questions.text: Why was Aaron not to come into the Most Holy Place at just any time?
questions.explanation: He was not to come at just any time, lest he die, for Yahweh would appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

answers.text: Yahweh would appear in the cloud on the mercy seat
The ark was too heavy and holy to be moved
The Levites guarded the veil day and night
Only Moses was allowed to enter the veil

questions.text: What were Aaron's holy garments for this day made of?
questions.explanation: He was to put on the holy linen tunic, linen trousers, linen sash and linen turban.

questions.text: How was it decided which goat was for Yahweh and which was the scapegoat?
questions.explanation: Aaron cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

answers.text: The first goat to come forward

questions.text: What was to cover the mercy seat so that Aaron would not die?
questions.explanation: Aaron put the incense on the fire before Yahweh so that the cloud of the incense would cover the mercy seat.

questions.text: On which side of the mercy seat did Aaron sprinkle the bull's blood?
questions.explanation: He sprinkled some of the blood of the bull with his finger on the mercy seat on the east.

questions.text: What did Aaron do with his hands over the live goat?
questions.explanation: Aaron laid both his hands on the head of the live goat and confessed over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel.

answers.text: Laid both hands on its head and confessed Israel's sins
Washed it in water and anointed it with oil
Sprinkled it with the bull's blood seven times
Lifted it up high as a wave offering

questions.text: Who was to take the live goat away into the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Aaron was to send the goat away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

questions.text: On what date was this statute to be kept each year?
questions.explanation: In the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, they were to afflict their souls and do no kind of work.

answers.text: The first month, on the fourteenth day
The seventh month, on the tenth day
The third month, on the first day
The twelfth month, on the last day

questions.text: How often was this atonement to be made for the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: It was an everlasting statute to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.
